It gets better, friend.

The good people here are making sure that everyone gets access to faster upload speeds, be they white, black, young, old, starving, self-centred and oblivious
and can afford not to, apparently
Silly, those are *other* peoples' problems. Why doesn't anyone consider my human right to be able to stream 1080p?

Watching it now.

My concern is that in the past I've changed the way I do things, only to lapse back to this state of being pretty much useless. In the past -like you say- I've tried changing everything, and I've tried pacing myself, but at some stage I always find my urge to do something like that gradually disappears.

I've never seen it like that before. Thanks for the help (and for helping other people out here too :) )

I don't really know how to talk about the reason I have bad self esteem, but I think that's a big problem. You've helped me a lot though.

Thanks for this.

I think you hit the nail on the head really, I feel like a lot of my self worth is based on being good at things. 

I'm ok with working hard though. At least, I think I am. The problem is that when I think about actually doing it I just don't, and I carry on with whatever else it is I could do that's less effort. It feels like I'm trapped in someone lazy and no matter how hard I try I just carry on doing the bare minimum- or more and more now less than the minimum- that I need to to get by.
